question: On a prospectively capable third cue family, does multi-task augmentation identify a shared H3 rank-one direction or a reusable rank-two operational subspace?
correction: V1 was invalid only because its sealed next/prior-stage bank failed native capability. Its intervention metrics are quarantined and do not set v2 axes, ranks, thresholds, or predictions. V2 changes only the sealed test authority to the capability-passed Next-year/Last-year bank.

frozen_design.fit: Exactly v1: pool all A1/A2 Later/Previously and future/past rows; compute pooled DIM; optimize one rank-one scalar-plus-0.3-centered-effect axis for 100 Adam updates; construct the rank-two union of separate task DIM axes.
frozen_design.test: All A1/A2 Next-year/Last-year rows, with no capable-row filtering.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capability_closure_and_: Capability manifest holds, full-rank closure <=1e-4, values finite, fit improves its own objective, and price is within the frozen maximum.
predictions.pred_b_task_augmentation_beats_single_ta: Pooled aligned rank 1 has lower full-vocabulary joint error than the frozen single-task axis on both panels.
predictions.pred_c_optimization_beats_pooled_dim: Pooled aligned rank 1 has lower full-vocabulary joint error than pooled DIM on both panels.
predictions.pred_d_rank2_union_identifies_shared_sub: Rank 2 has lower full-vocabulary joint error than every rank 1 and absolute scalar complement fraction <=0.30 on both panels.
predictions.pred_e_rank2_improvement_is_behavioral: Rank 2 has lower scalar joint error than every rank 1 and is donorward on >=90% of rows in both panels.

decision: shared_rank2 if A,D,E pass; shared_rank1 if A,B,C pass and pooled aligned is no worse than rank2; otherwise task_conditioned; invalid if A fails.
